name: Mack
title: Yoga Instructor
excerpt: Coach Mack helps athletes build the strength, mobility, and flexibility to move better and recover smarter.
bio: Coach Mackenzie's path to yoga started in competitive gymnastics, a sport she began at a young age and later transitioned into coaching. That early relationship with movement sparked a deeper interest in how the body works, eventually leading her to become a certified yoga instructor. Today, Mackenzie focuses on building strength, mobility, and flexibility, helping athletes move better, recover faster, and feel their best both on and off the mat.
